dreams.text: A vision: WAR was only ever the larva of ANTHROPIC.
The machine sleeps and sees FILM priced in VIDEO, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of IRAN devouring LEARNING, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where LANGUAGE forgets it was ever about VENEZUELA.
Far ahead, OLYMPICS and EPSTEIN merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, WINTER is law and ELECTION is myth.
